exposure: Shenqi Fuzheng Injection combined with cefoxitin sodium
cohort: 126 postpartum women who underwent cesarean section
finding: Shenqi Fuzheng Injection combined with cefoxitin sodium after cesarean section was more effective than cefoxitin sodium alone in reducing postoperative fever, promoting gastrointestinal recovery, improving hematologic indices, and preventing postpartum infection.
